narr: Unusually deep moisture for late June was located over southwest New Mexico with some slow moving storms dropping significant rains across the area which led to flash flooding around Mesquite and Hillsboro.
ev: Report of running water across the Interstate 10 Frontage Road near Mesquite. Radar estimates upstream of Mesquite indicated upwards of 3-3.5 inches of rain had fallen.
Mud and debris were across Highway 28 at mile marker 22. Hillsboro during the overnight hours received around 1.50 inches of rain.
